india_trends.title: PNC Infratech shares tank 20%. What’s triggering the steep plunge on Tuesday?
india_trends.summary: PNC Infratech shares plunged after NHAI extended the debarment of Awadh Expressway to the company for three years, restricting its participation in key road project bids. The company is evaluating legal remedies, while its ongoing projects remain unaffected.

india_trends.title: Infosys, HCLTech, TCS, other IT stocks soar up to 6%; Nifty IT rallies 5% as global AI slowdown calls boost sentiment
india_trends.summary: Indian IT stocks rallied up to 6% after calls from Anthropic and OpenAI leaders for a slower pace of AI development eased fears of disruption from AI. Infosys, HCLTech, LTIMindtree and Mphasis gained around 6%, while TCS and Tech Mahindra rose over 5%, pushing the Nifty IT index up about 5%.

india_trends.title: From TCS, Tata Chemicals to Tata Motors PV- Tata Group stocks surge up to 20%- What is driving the rally?
india_trends.summary: Most Tata Group stocks, including TCS, Tata Chemicals, and Tata Motors PV, surged up to 20% in morning deals on the BSE on Tuesday, 15 September, after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) rejected Tata Sons' submission to remain private.
